training: 60 discovery pairs, five families. Family/pair/token-balanced uncentered second moment of donor-minus-recipient residual. Equivalent to covariance of both signed orientations. No downstream loss used.
other_ports: Native; paired interventions transfer exact donor other ports, matching H1035.
evaluation: Same H1035 competent historical whole-task exclusions; opened diagnostic panel, not fresh validation.
center: Both bases use identical discovery activation center for whole-state reconstruction. Center cancels in paired changes.
limits: Task-change covariance is supervision by paired data, not finite causal-loss training. Same rank, not same training statistic.
